description: This file defines the abstract class 'Graph' and companion object 'Graph' for the Apache Spark GraphX library, including methods for graph construction, transformation, and analysis.

classes.name: Graph
classes.description: An abstract class representing a graph with vertices and edges, providing methods for graph operations such as caching, partitioning, mapping, subgraph extraction, and message aggregation.

methods.name: persist
methods.description: Caches the vertices and edges at a specified storage level.

methods.name: cache
methods.description: Caches the graph at previously specified storage levels.

methods.name: checkpoint
methods.description: Marks the graph for checkpointing to a file.

methods.name: isCheckpointed
methods.description: Checks if the graph has been checkpointed.

methods.name: getCheckpointFiles
methods.description: Returns the files where the graph was checkpointed.

methods.name: partitionBy
methods.description: Repartitions the edges according to a specified partition strategy.

methods.name: mapVertices
methods.description: Transforms vertex attributes using a provided function.

methods.name: mapEdges
methods.description: Transforms edge attributes using a provided function.

methods.name: mapTriplets
methods.description: Transforms edge triplets with access to vertex data.

methods.name: reverse
methods.description: Reverses all edges in the graph.

methods.name: subgraph
methods.description: Creates a subgraph based on vertex and edge predicates.

methods.name: mask
methods.description: Restricts the graph to vertices and edges present in another graph.

methods.name: groupEdges
methods.description: Merges multiple edges between the same vertices into a single edge.

methods.name: aggregateMessages
methods.description: Aggregates messages from neighboring edges and vertices.

methods.name: outerJoinVertices
methods.description: Joins vertices with an external table and updates vertex data.
